$comment: DATA, not code (yomizaka#228). The notice windows are those of art. 1942 C.c.Q.; the yearly figures of the TAL's method are entered here, one entry per year, each with the page it was read from and the day it was entered. A year with no entry gives no figure: the radar then says so and shows this table's source. Never a percentage in code.
